attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: wf_ae_005
steps:
  - id: move_pdf_to_completados
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      service: google_drive
      action: move_file
      source_folder: pending
      destination_folder: completados
      file_type: pdf
      file_id: "{{trigger.article.source_pdf_id}}"
    output: move_result

  - id: read_category_spreadsheet
    op: read_database
    params:
      source: google_sheets
      spreadsheet_id: "{{config.category_spreadsheet_id}}"
      sheet_name: "{{trigger.article.category}}"
    output: spreadsheet_data

  - id: update_article_row
    op: write_database
    params:
      target: google_sheets
      spreadsheet_id: "{{config.category_spreadsheet_id}}"
      sheet_name: "{{trigger.article.category}}"
      row_id: "{{trigger.article.row_id}}"
      updates:
        status: published
        published_date: "{{trigger.article.published_date}}"
        file_location: completados
    output: update_result

  - id: write_audit_log
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: post_publication_file_management
      article_id: "{{trigger.article.id}}"
      details:
        file_moved: true
        source_folder: pending
        destination_folder: completados
        spreadsheet_updated: true
        status_set: published
      timestamp: "{{system.current_timestamp}}"
    output: audit_entry
